Maya: quick flag 1 ZephyrX-int8 funcall canary shows parse rejects up ~5.6% when routed through fallback.
Akiko: concrete examples?
Maya: model sometimes returns array-wrapped args or null metadata where schema expects object. pasted minimal samples in artifacts.
Jon: suspicious that routing adds a tiny diagnostic prefix that shifts token boundaries. Lina: int8 config used per-channel asymmetric + KV compression which can shift alignments too.
Sam: mitigation options: (1) lightweight sanitizer that normalizes array->object and null->{} for canaries only, plus semantic recheck; (2) reranker/predecode to prefer object-shaped outputs; (3) temporary relax subschema gate for onboarding job.
Akiko: I'll prototype parse_repair.py with unit tests and an opt-in flag for canaries. It will do: single-element array -> unpack, null->{}, strip trailing commas, basic string->json unwrapping.
Lina: I'll run routing-variant matrix (mirror-only, mirror+liteq, liteq-only) with `./dev/run_canary.sh --model zephyrx-int8 --suite funcall_struct --limit 300` and attach per-route CSVs.
Maya: metrics: baseline float32 parse-fail ~0.8% -> int8 routed ~5.6%. Target: sanitizer+rerank <1.5% parse-fail and semantic regression <0.5% vs baseline to greenlight.
canary-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://canaries.internal/6278909999/report.json
Jon: agreed action items: Lina/Sam run matrix, Akiko protos sanitizer PR, Jon to relax gate for job, Maya to run semantic acceptability checks. Revisit EOD.
